messages:
mara: Heads up — ClearWave just escalated: embedding p99 tail spiking ~3x since ~03:00 UTC. They say throughput steady but client-facing latency is breaching their SLA window. Can folks call out owners and a short workaround timeline? Need clear commits (who, what, ETA). @eng-platform @eng-oncall

leo_oncall: I'm on it. Bridge created and we're watching. Short-term mitigation: reduced retry burst and disabled cross-customer queuing for their tenant. Will need infra + ml help for fallback model path.

infra-bot: deploybot: Incident channel created -> #incident-1765132468. Bridge link: https://bridge.internal/1765132468. Alerting rules muted for noisy paging during triage.

ben_dev: I can own a model fallback. Plan: pin ClearWave to quantized-v1 baseline (no KV optimizations) while we investigate kernel perf. ETA: 30m to stage deploy, 90–120m to Canary -> gradual roll to prod. I'll post PR in ~10m.

sasha: I can take routing and policy changes. I’ll add an explicit route to fallback pool for that tenant and lower batch size there to avoid long tail. Need infra permission to bump pool capacity by +1 node for 1h.

mara: Ben, please also include a short test plan for quality smoke. Sasha, confirm nodes request and patch snippet. Leo, coordinate canary window. Evan, QA evals after rollback.

evan-ml: Will run the RapidEval suite against the rollback model and the current prod model; aim to surface regressions within 45m. If we see >3% quality drop on targeted prompts we won't promote.

ben_dev: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pulls/412 — rollback config + deploy manifest. Quick commands for infra if needed:
```bash
# force route for tenant cw-123 to fallback pool
kubectl patch configmap tenant-routing -n redwood --type merge -p '{"data":{"cw-123":"fallback-pool"}}'
# scale fallback pool up 1 replica
kubectl scale deployment fallback-pool -n redwood --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy fallback-pool -n redwood -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+1))
```

sasha: Confirmed request for +1 node. infra team, please approve asap (we'll release after canary window).

leo_oncall: Canary window: start at +30m, 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 30m if no regressions. I'll watch p99 and error budget.

mara: Thanks. Actionable owners: Ben -> model fallback and deploy (ETA staging 30m), Sasha -> routing + pool bump (request filed), Evan -> evals (45m), Leo -> canary watch & rollback authority. I'll own comms with ClearWave and update them at +60m.

ben_dev: starting staging deploy now. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

evan-ml: kicked off evals — will post results in this thread.

sasha: pool bump approved by infra; will execute after Ben confirms staging green.

leo_oncall: monitoring dashboards + paging rules set. If p99 remains >2.5x baseline after canary, we revert.

mara: perfect. please keep updates concise here. once we have Canary pass/fail we’ll decide next steps.
